mantra_gayatri.name: Gayatri Mantra
mantra_gayatri.text: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
mantra_gayatri.translation: We meditate on the glory of that Creator; Who has created the Universe; Who is worthy of Worship; Who is the embodiment of Knowledge and Light; Who is the remover of all Sins and Ignorance; May He enlighten our Intellect.
mantra_gayatri.how_to_chant: Chant 108 times at sunrise, noon, or sunset facing East or North using a Rudraksha or Tulsi mala.
mantra_gayatri.benefits: Improves concentration, cleanses the mind, bestows wisdom, and aligns one with cosmic solar consciousness.

mantra_mahamrityunjaya.name: Mahamrityunjaya Mantra
mantra_mahamrityunjaya.text: ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान् मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात् ॥
mantra_mahamrityunjaya.translation: We worship the three-eyed Lord Shiva, who is fragrant and who nourishes all beings. May He liberate us from death for the sake of immortality, even as a cucumber is severed from its bond to the creeper.
mantra_mahamrityunjaya.how_to_chant: Chant 108 times in the morning or near Shiva Linga. Best done with a Rudraksha mala.
mantra_mahamrityunjaya.benefits: Provides health, prevents untimely death, resolves physical diseases, and bestows deep mental peace.

puja_satyanarayan.name: Satyanarayan Puja
puja_satyanarayan.text: Lord Satyanarayan is the embodiment of Truth. The worship is dedicated to Lord Vishnu.
puja_satyanarayan.translation: He who resides in truth and sustains the universe with love.
puja_satyanarayan.how_to_chant: Usually performed on Purnima (Full Moon) day of any month or during special family events.
puja_satyanarayan.benefits: Brings harmony, happiness, removes family disputes, and ensures success in business or new ventures.

aarti_ganesh.name: Jai Ganesh Deva Aarti
aarti_ganesh.text: जय गणेश जय गणेश जय गणेश देवा । माता जाकी पारवती पिता महादेवा ॥
aarti_ganesh.translation: Glory to Lord Ganesha, whose mother is Goddess Parvati and whose father is Lord Shiva.
aarti_ganesh.how_to_chant: Sing at sunset or sunrise during daily puja while waving a ghee lamp.
aarti_ganesh.benefits: Removes all life obstacles and fills the home with joy, health, and wisdom.
